title: Decide what a CDN may do with a response
acceptanceCriteria: A request that carried `Authorization` is stored only when the response says `public`, `s-maxage` or `must-revalidate`
The lifetime is `s-maxage` when present, otherwise `max-age`; an age below it → `fresh`, at or above it → stale
`no-cache` is stored, but every reuse is `revalidate`
Stale but inside the `stale-while-revalidate` window → `serve-stale-and-refresh`; past it → `revalidate`
`must-revalidate` forbids serving stale: once stale, it's `revalidate` even inside the window
